INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.anchor: signal.stop_price + 2 * signal.meta.atr_price = native signal-bar EMA21. Fixed absolute limit, never revised or chased.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.cancel: No discretionary economic cancellation; expire fixed TTL. Fixture cancel proves no later fills. Incomplete/late setup rejects before order.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.causal_input: Received closed 1m OHLC and all-six cumulative prefix ready for closed30m native features; frozen seed/config assumed available before development window, not live certified.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.comparator: Frozen saved parent market-next-minute execution on identical setup/data/window/receipt clocks/cost/fit/native management; no parent replay. Verify setup stream pin within reserved candidate FULL.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.end: No force close. Pending/position unresolved disclosed separately, no fabricated terminal equity.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.episode: Exactly one order per native first-release symbol/signal boundary; no same-episode rearm. Later independent episodes retain native setup.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.expires_ms: signal_open_ms + 2*1800000; expiry before touch at equality
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.fill: For an active minute low<=limit, model entry at limit including opening gap lower than limit: pessimistic upper entry-price bound, not observed transaction.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.fill_clock: Minute-open cohort timestamp; actual intraminute touch time unknown; witness=max(minuteclose,source_received). Exclude entire fill minute and its incomplete30m bar from management/excursions.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.management: Unchanged native management decisions only full30m bars whose open>=fillminuteopen+60000 and entire feature prefix has arrived; strict next minute after all-six ready. No new exit tuning.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.occupancy: Pending order owns symbol until expiry timer; filled position until outcome witness inclusive. Unresolved/pending-end retains occupancy. Other symbols independent. No fabricated exchange acknowledgments.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.order_kind: BUY_LIMIT full modeled size, charge full frozen taker cost; no maker/fill certainty claim.
INTERNAL_HYPOTHESIS.same_minute_path: If entry and stop touch same minute, adverse entry-before-stop. If opening gap below stop, model entry at adverse limit bound then exit at gap open.
